headline: Approved moving $1,188,100 from special education salaries to contracted services to cover vacant positions.
summary: The meeting covered the monthly financial report through September 30, a MainePERS audit update, and a facilities update. Members voted to approve a transfer of $1,188,100 from special education salaries and benefits to special education contracted services. The transfer covers September through December.
decisions: Approved moving $1,188,100 from special education salaries and benefits to special education contracted services. The motion passed.
discussion: Special education transfer: Members asked whether contracted services cost more than hiring staff and how the money was budgeted for the school year.
Special education spending: A public speaker asked for a breakdown of contracted services, including the sites, services, and number of students covered.
MainePERS audit: Staff said the account review is speeding up, with 1,600 accounts processed so far out of about 10,000 total.
Heating failures: Staff reported problems at about eight schools and the failure of two boilers at district office, plus a $45,000 pump replacement at Longfellow.
Aging buildings: Members discussed the cost of old heating systems and buildings, and whether the city should share in emergency repair costs.
